Why go: a real sailing yacht with a skipper and hostess

Independence is a 52 ft sailing monohull: the classic yacht that leans into the wind, with an Italian skipper and a Thai hostess on board. It is built around couples and small families, with prices for two that include hotel transfers and drinks, and a menu of trips from a 3-hour sunset to a 5-day cruise.

What you'll do

The most popular trip is the sunset sail towards Koh Som and Koh Phangan with wine and tapas. Early risers can book a sunrise champagne breakfast; others choose a half or full day to Koh Phangan for swimming and snorkelling from the dinghy, a night of fishing out of Bang Rak Bay, or a long day to Ang Thong from 16 December. The overnights and the sailing-and-yoga trip let you anchor in quiet bays and wake up at sea.

Who it suits

  • Honeymooners and couples who want to actually sail, not just cruise.
  • Families with up to 3 children under 16 on the family package.
  • Travellers who want a slow overnight with everything arranged.

Who should choose something else

  • Groups larger than 6: see Kia Ora.
  • Anyone prone to seasickness: a catamaran such as Blue Coco stays flatter.

Good to know

  • Sailing: a monohull heels under sail; keep one hand for the boat when moving around.
  • Weather: October to December brings the strongest winds; the skipper may shorten or reroute trips.
  • Ang Thong: closed from 1 November to 15 December.

Before you book

Tell us the trip, the number of adults and children and their ages. We confirm the price for your group, the pickup time and the dock, and for overnights and the yoga trip we agree the route and meals with the skipper.
